goal: Make SummonScout hot-capable Lua changes automatically propagate through the existing Parallel addon packaging workflow by fanning every non-directly-watched SummonScout_*Hot.lua module into an already watched live-reload host, without requiring manual per-file watcher updates.
notes: Existing direct native watch paths stay unchanged. The normal Parallel addon packager now turns SummonScout_WhisperConfirmSpam.lua into a watched fanout carrier for every TOC-declared SummonScout_*Hot.lua module that is not already watched/hosted directly. Cold load skips the fanout to avoid duplicate registration; live reload replays the fanout in TOC order. Packaging fails closed when a non-direct Hot source is missing from the TOC or when the generated watched payload reaches the native 262144-byte cap. This includes SummonScout_RosterOwnershipHot.lua, so the current WTB+taxi parser hotfix is carried by the same automatic path.
